node_definition.done_when: A test drives a read-only run to promotable in a temporary RECKON_HOME and repository, takes the offered next_action, fills only its placeholders and runs it: the run promotes. The same test against the base revision's offered command observes the refusal ("cites ... as its own work, but that is the base"). A run with commits beyond its base still gets its --commit list. Tests naming next_action or review-ready are recorded as flat baseline_suite and after_suite records.
node_definition.goal: Make the promotion command offered for a read-only run one that crew complete accepts, per the-obligations-hook-reads-a-snapshot §19. When a promotable run's only recorded commit equals its dispatch base, the next action the recovery classifier offers (and so the obligations hook) names crew complete with --gate not-run, a --no-commit reason placeholder and an --outcome placeholder, and never cites the base sha as --commit.
